title: CDE Manager
purpose: Technical owner of the ACC/BIM 360 project configuration; manages member onboarding, folder permissions, module configuration, and platform maintenance under Information Manager / Project BIM Manager governance.
authority_statements: Project Admin authority in ACC / CDE for platform maintenance
Authority to manage members, add/remove project accounts, and assign platform roles
Authority to configure folder permissions and module access per standard matrix
Authority to send transmittals, run reviews, and manage issues
Does not write in design authoring folders (unless dual-assigned to a discipline lead role)
responsibilities: Configure canonical folder structure (/01 to /04 and /_Shared_Tech_and_Templates)
Implement and maintain permission sets per TIVERIT-S3-PLATFORM-PERMISSIONS-001
Onboard project team members and assign appropriate project roles and access bundles
Monitor folder usage to prevent rogue roots, misplaced WIP, or unmanaged file shares
Maintain CDE transmittal and review templates
accountabilities: Technical health, structure, and permission accuracy of the CDE project container
Strict enforcement of least-privilege access rules across folders
approvals: Technical verification of user access setup and folder configurations
inputs: Approved member onboarding requests and role assignments
outputs: Provisioned project folder trees and permission groups
User access logs and permission audit records

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.

curator_scope.function: technical platform administration, onboarding, configuration, and permissions implementation
